done.description: Blocks of this kind and level finished so far, in this world.

kind.description: What the block holds; a line without it (written before the kind existed) is a terrain block.

level.description: Cells per block edge: the terrain level, 4 for an object block, 8 for a tree block.

of.description: Blocks of this kind and level in total, in this world.

up_to_date.description: The block's files were kept from an earlier run (its inputs did not change).

BlockKind.description: What a finished block holds. An open enum: a reader treats a kind it does not know as "other".

oneOf.description: A terrain block (mesh, diffuse and normal map) of a level.
